headline: HEG Limited: Change in Management Following Composite Scheme of Arrangement
sum: HEG Limited announces cessation of senior management personnel effective 1 September 2026, following the effectiveness of a Composite Scheme of Arrangement whereby their employment transfers to HEG Graphite Limited. The restructuring reflects the completion of the scheme's implementation, triggering a formal change-of-control disclosure to the stock exchange.
implication: Where a composite scheme results in transfer of employment of senior management to a scheme-entity, the parent company must promptly disclose cessation to the exchange; this signals NCLT-sanctioned restructurings often involve post-scheme operational transfers and require careful attention to employee/key-person continuity documentation.
detail: HEG Limited informed the NSE of the cessation of senior management personnel (names not disclosed in the filing) consequent upon their transfer of employment to HEG Graphite Limited. The transfer occurred pursuant to a Composite Scheme of Arrangement that became effective on 1 September 2026. This is a formal management succession event triggered by the implementation of a scheme approved by NCLT, indicating a shift in operational structure and subsidiary/holding company relationships post-scheme effectiveness. The disclosure was filed on 24 August 2026, prior to the effective date.
